game.name: Banjo-Kazooie
game.rules:
Timing

- Timer begins when you start a new game
- If using Demo Desync Adventure (DDA), timer starts at the beginning of the intro cutscene fadeout (add +1.2 seconds to final time if timing from intro completely fading to black)
- Timer ends on final shot on Jinjonator
- Timer may also end on a final collectable provided all the other requirements for the category have been met (i.e already beating Grunty). This timing method does not allow resetting the console or relaunching the game to skip saving Grunty as defeated. The run must be completed with the file recognizing that you've defeated her when you pick up your last collectible (ex. boulder in Spiral Mountain, no random Grunty's Lair text, last jiggy brings you to SnS cutscene, etc.)

In-game Rules

- [Furnace Fun Moves (FFM)](https://shorturl.at/9RDTu) is allowed in all categories unless stated otherwise
- [Demo Desync Adventure (DDA)](https://shorturl.at/j6qox) is allowed in applicable categories. DDA cannot collect 100% of the game's totals so it is not allowed in 100%
- The use of sandcastle cheats are prohibited

- The use of save states on Nintendo Switch is not allowed during a run. However, loading a save state before a run begins is allowed (FFM save state, Grunty timer save state, etc.)

Platforms and submission process

- All runs must have full video evidence
- Playing on an everdrive is allowed
- Nintendo 64 Emulator is allowed but if you specifically wish to use Project 64, you must use version 1.7 or earlier (After a [security vulnerbility](https://shorturl.at/g1bta) was found in Project 64 1.6/1.7, we now recommend using other emulators such as [RetroArch](https://shorturl.at/hHd2v))
- Any runs on the "FFM Instant" ROMhack are not allowed
- Xbox 360 emulator (Xenia) is banned. (Tests were done on this emulator and it was proven to be faster than official Xbox releases)

levels.name: Spiral Mountain
levels.rules:
**Timing**

- Timing starts on the first frame you press A to create a file (See Practice ROM Rules for more info)
- Timing ends on the first frame the screen goes black after entering the lair

**Practice ROM (Snapper)**

- The Snapper Practice ROM is allowed but all hacks must be disabled
- Save States are welcomed but are only allowed before the run starts

**Submission Process**

- Collecting all six honeycombs are required

- The run must be done as if it was your first time entering Spiral Mountain on that file

- Full video proof of completion must be given

levels.name: Mumbo's Mountain

games.name: Banjo-Kazooie
games.rules:
Timing

- Timer begins when you start a new game
- If using Demo Desync Adventure (DDA), timer starts at the beginning of the intro cutscene fadeout (add +1.2 seconds to final time if timing from intro completely fading to black)
- Timer ends on final shot on Jinjonator
- Timer may also end on a final collectable provided all the other requirements for the category have been met (i.e already beating Grunty). This timing method does not allow resetting the console or relaunching the game to skip saving Grunty as defeated. The run must be completed with the file recognizing that you've defeated her when you pick up your last collectible (ex. boulder in Spiral Mountain, no random Grunty's Lair text, last jiggy brings you to SnS cutscene, etc.)

In-game Rules

- [Furnace Fun Moves (FFM)](https://shorturl.at/9RDTu) is allowed in all categories unless stated otherwise
- [Demo Desync Adventure (DDA)](https://shorturl.at/j6qox) is allowed in applicable categories. DDA cannot collect 100% of the game's totals so it is not allowed in 100%
- The use of sandcastle cheats are prohibited

- The use of save states on Nintendo Switch is not allowed during a run. However, loading a save state before a run begins is allowed (FFM save state, Grunty timer save state, etc.)

Platforms and submission process

- All runs must have full video evidence
- Playing on an everdrive is allowed
- Nintendo 64 Emulator is allowed but if you specifically wish to use Project 64, you must use version 1.7 or earlier (After a [security vulnerbility](https://shorturl.at/g1bta) was found in Project 64 1.6/1.7, we now recommend using other emulators such as [RetroArch](https://shorturl.at/hHd2v))
- Any runs on the "FFM Instant" ROMhack are not allowed
- Xbox 360 emulator (Xenia) is banned. (Tests were done on this emulator and it was proven to be faster than official Xbox releases)

levels.name: Grunty Fight
levels.rules:
**Timing**

- Timing starts the first frame the screen goes black after touching the loading zone for the Grunty Fight
- Timing ends on the first frame the Jinjonator cutscene starts

**Practice ROM (Snapper)**

- The Snapper Practice ROM is allowed but all hacks must be disabled
- Save States are welcomed but are only allowed before the run starts

**Submission Process**

- The run must be done as if it was your first time entering the battle, which means: 
- No text can be skippable with just B (L+R+B is fair game) 
- Jinjo Statue Rising Cutscene must play during the run 
- Jinjonator Statue Rising Cutscene must play during the run
- Full video proof of completion must be given
